repeat_rule: Use the existing stable paired timing rule; two repeats when both absolute timing differences are <=2%, otherwise one third repeat. Keep all samples.
fairness: Same frozen requests/routes/weights/teacher tokens within each cache setting.
Same V3 runtime, P=2, T2, BF16 transport, NUMA/CPU affinity, eviction policy and NCCL settings for every policy.
Only cache capacity and admission policy may differ.
BR is the denominator for all policy gains within the same cache setting.
Do not include standalone LA or demand-locality CA(id=1) in this experiment.
